test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 11 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. All W are T.

II. All M are W.

Conclusion:

I. All M are T.

II. Some T are W.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0805ad8f361caf1952fb4b910b31623c36c5bf1b08b1a8089928bb26f0ec798c.png] 

Conclusion:

I. All M are T. → **Follows **(As, All W are T and All M are W)

II. Some T are W. → **Follows** (As, All W are T)

Hence, '**Both conclusions I and II follows**' is the correct answer.
